question: A Cisco Nexus 7000 Series switch runs VXLAN, and interface Ethernet 7/30 is configured as a trunk port. Which command set configures the switch to act as a gateway for VLAN 507?
context:
interface Ethernet7/30
  no switchport
  no shutdown
  service instance 1 vni
  no shutdown
  encapsulation profile VSI_50_TO_500 default
options: encapsulation profile VSI_50_TO_500 dot1q 50 vni 500 bridge-domain 50 member vni 500 interface Bdi50 ip address 10.50.50.51/24
encapsulation profile VSI_50_TO_500 dot1q 500 vni 50 bridge-domain 500 member vni 50 interface Bdi500 ip address 10.50.50.51/24
encapsulation profile VSI_50_TO_500 dot1q 500 vni 50 bridge-domain 500 member vni 50 interface Vlan500 ip address 10.50.50.51/24
encapsulation profile VSI_50_TO_500 dot1q 50 vni 500 bridge-domain 50 member vni 500 interface Vlan50 ip address 10.50.50.51/24
theory: On the Nexus 7000's F3-based VXLAN gateway implementation, a Layer 2 trunk's dot1q-tagged VLAN is mapped into a VXLAN bridge domain and its VNI through an encapsulation profile, which binds a specific dot1q VLAN tag to a target VNI and bridge-domain number. The Layer 3 gateway function for that segment is then provided by a Bridge-Domain Interface (a BDI, such as interface Bdi50), the SVI-equivalent construct used in this dot1q/bridge-domain model rather than a traditional interface Vlan SVI, so the profile must reference the matching dot1q tag, VNI, and bridge-domain number consistently, with the gateway IP address applied to the corresponding BDI. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 3 — VXLAN Gateway Configuration on Nexus 7000)
